The United States of America under the presidency of George W. Bush, from 2001 to 2009.

senses.definition: The parts of the United States of America where George W. Bush finds high support; Bush’s geographical support base.
senses.example: But while Bush is not yet working on a victory speech for a year from tonight, there is optimism in Bushland. “We’re winning,” a top Bush aide said as the candidate prepped for a recent speech.
